notes.title: It's Oktoberfest Time: Update 1.1.4 Adds New Outfits and Fixes to Hell Pie! 🍻
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/332959e048d2bacd26a617dc485cb49be863e6bb.jpg[/img]

Grüß Gott, dear platformers!

It's finally that time again: Tomorrow, the world's biggest booze-up finally starts in idyllic Munich (after two alcohol-free years of corona-induced break): [b]Oktoberfest[/b]! So grab your dirndl, lederhosen and chamois beard and get the party started! 🍻

And where alcohol excesses take place, Nate and Nugget are not far behind! And that's why the new [b]Hell Pie[/b] update 1.1.4 - in celebration of Oktoberfest starting tomorrow - brings new outfits into play:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/8e8e697354ada07c4cc84665c8627200d648c740.jpg[/img]

In addition, a few small problems are fixed. Here is the complete (tiny) changelog:
[list][*] Lederhose + Dirndl outfit added
[*] Beermug outfit for Nugget added
[*] Various localization fixes
[*] Various minor fixes[/list]
Have a great time swinging with lerderhosen Nate and dirndl Nugget!
Sluggerfly out ❤️

notes.title: 🛠️ Hell Pie Update 1.1.3 is live + Soundtrack is available now! 🎶

notes.title: First Hell Pie Update to be released soon + emotional words from Sluggerfly! ❤️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/6d23582d3b5b03afc857136ac6ba17d0531415e2.jpg[/img]

Greetings platformers!

We hope you had a lovely week so far. We definitely have! Honestly, we are so [b]F*CKING BLOWN AWAY[/b] by the awesome feedback we received (and receive) for [b]Hell Pie[/b]! Holy moly! When working on a game like [b]Hell Pie[/b], you constantly get comments like [i]"Grow up!"[/i], [i]"I can't see how this is funny!"[/i] or [i]"What kind of late-pubescent garbage is this?"[/i]. And even worse. Not that we're not used to it....

But: We are damn proud of this "late-pubescent garbage" that we've done! [b]In your face, you bores and buzzkills![/b]

And that's exactly why it's so good to see that we get such awesome feedback. Hey, we've been working on [b]Hell Pie[/b] for 5 long years. Sure, it's nothing compared to Duke Nukem Forever, but it's still a long time.

But no one is flawless. And so, even after all the years of hard work and endless optimization, there are still a few bugs hidden in [b]Hell Pie[/b]. (And not just the one in the server room!) But because we love you all soooooo much (and because we got some reports, ideas and feedback from you) we are working on the first update which should be released soon. But there is no exact date yet. At the latest when the residual alcohol from the release party has finally disappeared from our bloodstream... (Man, it was a hell of a night... But, what happens in Essen stays in Essen!)

[b]Among other things, we will address the following issues with the first update:[/b]
[list][*] The dialogs of Nugget will be deactivatable
[*] The Auto Cam will be deactivatable
[*] The dialogs of Nugget will - if activated - be triggered less often
[*] The bug of the no longer spawning tickets at Dr. Jell will be fixed[/list]
Other than that, we're cleaning up some small stuff in [b]Hell Pie[/b]: spelling mistakes, missing translations, holes in the maps (wherever they come from...). We will of course let you know asap once the update is available!

And I can almost smell the question growing in your heads: Will there be more content for [b]Hell Pie[/b] in the future? A good question, but so far there is no answer. There will definitely be updates with more costumes. But whether there will be new levels, DLCs, etc. will ultimately be decided by how successful [b]Hell Pie[/b] will be overall. We have a lot of ideas, that's for sure. We will keep you up to date.

Have a great time swinging with Nate and Nugget!
Sluggerfly out

notes.title: Nate, Nugget & Ray: Hell Pie swings with Ray Tracing & Nvidia DLSS for Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/9aad7201ba7459864b51dd8c631ecf7f872c22b8.jpg[/img]

Greetings techy platformers!

I'm not quite sure if we subconsciously foreshadowed the following five years when we came up with the name [b]Hell Pie[/b] for our latest project. Because any developer will agree that the word "hell" is probably the most apt description of the time in which a game is made. Actually, according to the planning, a development should always take two years less, and offer at least 50% more content, which fell into the gutter somewhere in all the mess. Washed away by all the blood, sweat and tears of disillusioned developers.

Or in short: developing games is awesome, but you need a thick skin. [b]Hell Pie[/b] is our third game, so we knew (more or less) what we were getting into. But what would the developer's life be boring if there weren't new challenges waiting somewhere to be heroically worked on?!? And so one fine day a year ago Tim (the PC tech & gaming enthusiast from Headup) came around the corner with an idea: [i]"The look and style of Hell Pie would look even more awesome with Ray Tracing than it already does! What do you guys think of the that?"[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/50daa511c9b38a11f52f43edd8627dd208056e60.jpg[/img]

To be honest: Not much at this moment. And perhaps that is why we agreed. Later I thought a bit about whether it makes sense for [b]Hell Pie[/b] to include Ray Tracing in a cartoony game at all. Doesn't that only look good in games that are as realistic as possible? I adressed that question with Tim, and he related me to Pumpkin Jack so that I should take a look on the Ray Tracing implementation of it. And what can I say, Pumpkin Jack clearly benefits from Ray Tracing, and so we (meaning mainly [b]me[/b]) got started together with [b]Nvidia[/b].

Since the beginning of 2021, I started actively working on adding Ray Tracing to [b]Hell Pie[/b]. And as always in the life of a developer, the theory sounds quite simple at first. The implementation then went more like this: [i]"So, let's get started. Well, seems to be easy going... But, nope. Not at all. F*ck... Maybe? Hm... No. Noooooo!!! F*ck. F*ck. F*CK F*CK F*CK!!! WHY?!? ... Well, at least it looks good. But where are my FPS? Dammit! Let's add DLSS... It works! Yes! I LOVE IT!!! That was worth it."[/i]

Ray Tracing does not turn [b]Hell Pie[/b] inside out. We use Ray Tracing partially so as not to break the style of the game, but to highlight some aspects. Ray Traced Reflections reflect in real time the environments, character, etc. in surfaces such as windows, water, mirrors, etc. And Ray Traced Ambient Occlusion causes a more realistic overall look in the levels when it comes to ... ambient occlusion. But (moving) pictures say more than a thousand words:

[previewyoutube=WWuhTuf38K8;full][/previewyoutube]
Personally, I like such gimmicks very much. RT Reflections, RT Ambient Occlusion, DLSS, etc. And that's why I put it in. Internally at Sluggerfly, however, not all are fans, because additional techniques like Ray Tracing also bring technical hurdles: suddenly some effects in the game don't work anymore, a workaround must be found, etc. It's been some back and forth, but we've added some cool gimmicks to [b]Hell Pie[/b]. I'm proud of it in any case!

And hey, exactly two weeks from tomorrow [b]Hell Pie[/b] will be released! Then you can see for yourself - with the appropriate hardware, of course - that a brightly colored, stylized 3D platformer like [b]Hell Pie[/b] works wonderfully with ray tracing. It doesn't always have to be realism. Life is already realistic enough.

See you soon, dear friends!
Christian & The Sluggerfly Team

notes.title: Swingers of the World unite: Hell Pie will release July 21st 2022! 📅
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/5dff09f1b6312c5216442fa6f1db0b9520a1aa4b.jpg[/img]

Beloved swingers,

The time has finally come! We have been working on [b]Hell Pie[/b] for about five years, which is a insane long time... (but not because the game is so big or polished, but because we are untalented and don't want to do any "real" work... Sorry!)

... Let's start over new... The time has finally come! Folks, after about five years of insanely hard work we have a release date for [b]Hell Pie[/b]! Yes, we know - unbelievable, but true. And it won't be that long anymore. Not another five years. Not even one more year. But just a little more than a month!

*drum rolls*

[h2][u][b]HELL PIE WILL RELEASE JULY 21st 2022!!![/b][/u][/h2]

[previewyoutube=fFzMPvz_w94;full][/previewyoutube]
And that's it. Dammit... That means that now we have to think about what we're going to do after the [b]Hell Pie[/b] release... We said we'd never ever clean deposit bottles again! Please people, help us! Please wishlisted [b]Hell Pie[/b] so that the game will be successful and we don't have to actually start working. Please! 😘

We'll work on the game a little bit after all. So that it becomes really really good! Promise! 🤞

Till then and take care everyone!
Your Sluggerfly Team
